name: Variant picker
summary: Choose color swatches or sizes. Options that are not available stay visible, struck through, and you cannot choose them.
use: Color, size or other variants on the product page.
avoid: More than about 12 options: use Select or Combobox.
anatomy: Legend with the chosen value (for color).
Optional link on the right, like "Size guide".
figmaProps: Color of a swatch via the fill of Color.
behaviour: Arrow keys move the choice (native radio).
a11y: Fieldset with a legend. Each swatch has a text name.
Not available is read out ("…, not available").
content: Color names the way customers say them: "Rust red", not "#B5473A".
dont: Hide sizes that are sold out: then customers keep looking for nothing.
